title: PF1 Magic Equipment
description: A backbone for applying magic properties to Pathfinder 1e weapons (and later armor): enhancement bonus, special abilities, and special materials, with automatic recomputation of value, weight, hp, hardness, and masterwork, plus runtime injection of ability effects.

requires.reason: Used to wrap PF1's ActionUse methods safely (footnotes, conditional-toggle capture) so the mod coexists with other modules that wrap the same methods.

recommends.reason: Optional integration: grant magic-equipment abilities to targeted weapons via roll-bonuses' targeting (e.g. a buff that temporarily makes a weapon axiomatic). The mod is fully functional without it.
